receipt.name: WarmBilinearResize
receipt.boundary: One resident original 513x259 RGBA8 raster to independently owned 1027x519 bilinear output. Complete public Resize, admission, allocation/materialization/disposal. Native public FFmpeg filter graph includes packed/planar conversion, zscale widened triangle kernel with straight-alpha metadata and internal encoded-space premultiplication/unpremultiplication, final RGBA conversion and output pixel acquisition/release. Graph/source/frame wrappers and geometry contexts are reused; each call filters the full input. Native padded output rows exposed directly. Managed exact rational-reference pixels; native RGB maximum1/RMSE0.25 existing filtered comparison bound, Down8 alpha exact; approved RGBA16/Up8 native-only alpha maximum1/RMSE0.25; Up8 writable output acquisition and zero-alpha RGB normalization are timed; zero-alpha RGBzero; native CLI/deterministic output exact. No output cache or expression evaluator. Startup, IPC, I/O, generation, hashing and validation excluded; one CPU/filter thread, normal SIMD. Only this selected geometry and depth are measured.
